words.ex: The star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A star is a large ball of burning gas in space that you can see as a point of light in the sky at night.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.tr:
adj. 美国的；美洲的；
n. 美国人；美洲人；
words.ex: She bought an American car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆美国车。
words.en: relating to the United States of America or its people, culture, or language

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.tr:
n. 一半；
adj. 一半的；
adv. 一半地；
words.ex: He ate half of the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了苹果的一半。
words.en: One of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很容易。
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: The children play on the street.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在街上玩耍。
words.en: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: The dog licked itself.
words.ex_cn: 狗舔了自己。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a thing or animal previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: It is quite cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天很冷。
words.en: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree; fairly.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一块蛋糕。
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: He bought a recent book about history.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本最近出版的历史书。
words.en: Having happened, begun, or been done not long ago or not long before; belonging to a past period comparatively close to the present.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙涂成蓝色。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上看新闻。
words.en: News is information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by newspapers, radio, television, or online media.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.ex_cn: 风从北方吹来。
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: He simply wants to go home.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想回家。
words.en: In a simple manner; without much complexity or difficulty.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第三名。
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.ex_cn: 他向前迈了一小步。
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算机做作业。
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.tr: adj. 共和国的；共和政体的；
words.ex: The republican government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 共和国政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A republican is a person who supports or belongs to the Republican Party, which is one of the two main political parties in the United States. It can also refer to someone who supports a republic as a form of government.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果是红的。
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.ex: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上公交车。
words.en: Almost, but not quite; very close to.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: She combs her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上梳头发。
words.en: Hair is the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans and animals, or the mass of such strands growing from the skin of a person's head.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看着天空。
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.ex: The first century had no computers.
words.ex_cn: 第一个世纪没有电脑。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.ex: He will arrive soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会到。
words.en: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.ex: My brother plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.ex_cn: 大厅里有一百名学生。
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: He is likely to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能赢得比赛。
words.en: If something is likely, it will probably happen or is expected.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他头发很短。
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.tr: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的；
words.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张单程公交车票。
words.en: Only one in number; one only; not married or not involved in a stable romantic relationship.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.ex: My daughter loves to read books.
words.ex_cn: 我的女儿喜欢读书。
words.en: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parents.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.tr:
num. 一千；
n. 千；千个；
words.ex: There are a thousand stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有一千颗星星。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten; 1,000.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: Anyone can learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 任何人都能学会阅读。
words.en: Any person at all; it does not matter who.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.ex: I did it myself.
words.ex_cn: 我自己做的。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of a verb or preposition when he or she is the subject of the clause.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；确定地；当然；
words.ex: He will certainly come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无疑问会来参加派对。
words.en: Without doubt; definitely.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.ex: He plays soccer as his favorite sport.
words.ex_cn: 他把足球当作最喜欢的体育运动。
words.en: Sport is a physical activity that is governed by a set of rules or customs and often engaged in competitively.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.ex: The cost is $5 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 每小时费用是5美元。
words.en: Used to express the rate at which something happens or the means by which something is done.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.ex: He throw the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To propel something through the air with a movement of the arm and hand.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.tr:
adj. 第二的；
n. 第二；秒；片刻；
adv. 第二；
words.ex: He got the second prize in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Second is used to describe something that is next after the first in order, rank, importance, or occurrence.

words.ex: He sleeps on a soft bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张柔软的床上。
words.en: A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on when you sleep.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: He lost a lot of blood after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。
words.en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.tr:
v. 逼迫；推；
n. 推；奋力；
words.ex: The teacher pushed the student to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师逼迫学生完成作业。
words.en: To exert force against (someone or something) in order to move them away from oneself or the origin of the force.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place; to become involved in a situation or activity; to begin a particular period or stage; to record information in a book or computer.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: He is taller than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟高。
words.en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: The soup is hot.
words.ex_cn: 汤是热的。
words.en: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 她通常走路去学校。
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.ex: He has seven apples in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他包里有七个苹果。
words.en: Seven is the number 7.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他远离了房子。
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.ex: He has eight apples in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他包里有八个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and four; one more than seven, or two less than ten; 8.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: The central park is in the middle of the city.
words.ex_cn: 中央公园位于城市中心。
words.en: Something that is central is of key or fundamental importance.

words.ex: He studied hard, thus he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr: adv. 确切地；正是；准确地；
words.ex: He arrived exactly at 8 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他正好在八点到达。
words.en: In a precise manner; accurately.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗在晚上大声吠叫。
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我准备好考试了。
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.ex: I prepare my lunch every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上准备午餐。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.ex: I recognize her face from school.
words.ex_cn: 我从学校认出了她的脸。
words.en: If you recognize someone or something, you know who or what they are because you have seen or heard them before.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.ex_cn: 他从杯子里喝水。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: She cleaned the room herself.
words.ex_cn: 她自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when the female subject of the verb is also the object.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.ex: Everybody likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Every person; everyone.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The election will be held next month.
words.ex_cn: 选举将在下个月举行。
words.en: An election is a process in which people vote to choose a person or group of people to hold an official position.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr: v. 放置；安放；下蛋；“lie”的过去式； adj. 外行的；非专业的；
words.ex: He lay the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something down gently or carefully.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我感觉明天会下雨。
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: He arrives at the station at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他早上8点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a place, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户是玻璃做的。
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.ex: My sister walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹每天走路去上学。
words.en: A sister is a woman or girl who has one or both parents in common with another individual.

words.tr: abbr. 下午；午后；“post meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: The meeting is at 3 pm.
words.ex_cn: 会议在下午3点。
words.en: PM is used to refer to the time from 12 noon to 12 midnight. It is an abbreviation for 'post meridiem', which is Latin for 'after midday'.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.tr:
adj. 好的；不错的；可以的
int. 好的；可以
words.ex: The food is OK.
words.ex_cn: 食物还不错。
words.en: An expression meaning 'all right' or 'acceptable', used to indicate approval or agreement.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个苹果。
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.ex: He has ten apples.
words.ex_cn: 他有十个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and two; one more than nine; 10.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.ex: He explained the problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地解释了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, read, or understand.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: He sings a happy song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上唱一首快乐的歌。
words.en: A song is a piece of music with words that is sung.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr: adv. 更确切地说；宁可；相当；
words.ex: I don't like coffee; rather, I prefer tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡；更确切地说，我更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use rather to indicate that something is true to a fairly great extent, especially when you are talking about something unpleasant or undesirable.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He proved the theorem with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的数学证明了这个定理。
words.en: To prove something means to show that it is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.tr:
v. 悬挂；吊；
n. 悬挂；
words.ex: He hangs a picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一幅画挂在墙上。
words.en: To hang something means to attach it to something else so that it is supported from above and does not touch the ground.

words.tr: adj. 全部的；整个的；完全的；
words.ex: He ate the entire cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: You use entire to emphasize that you are referring to the whole of something, for example, the whole of a place, time, or population.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.tr:
prep. 自…以后；从…以来；
conj. 因为；由于；既然；从…以后；
adv. 此后；后来；
words.ex: He has lived here since 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他自2020年以来一直住在这里。
words.en: From a past time until now; because; as a result of the fact that.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的；
words.ex: The weather today is nice.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: If you say that something is nice, you mean that you find it attractive, pleasant, or enjoyable.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我知道他明天会来。
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.tr: n. 民主主义者；民主党员；
words.ex: He is a democrat who believes in equal rights for all.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信所有人平等权利的民主主义者。
words.en: A democrat is someone who believes in the principles of democracy, such as the idea that everyone should have an equal say in how their country is governed.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.tr:
n. 照料；谨慎；关心；
v. 关心；在意；在乎；
words.ex: The nurse gave the baby good care.
words.ex_cn: 护士给了婴儿很好的照料。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我们今晚一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The boy kicked the ball into the net.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把球踢进了网里。
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as soccer, baseball, and basketball. It can also refer to a formal dance.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: The company made a statement about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 公司就新政策发布了一项声明。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.
